authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9500 *bhiyagna wet explicitly gives Oriya bhigā and the bhig- verb family, distinguishing the g-bearing stem from *bhiyajyate 9502. The simple bhig/big wet responses preserve that stem, with regional l-participial endings, aspiration and inflection qualified. No underlying nasal is supplied where the survey has none; the precise local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: bīga.
